On non-CVMs, requires hatch_avatar_video_api; when the gate is off, returns an empty array before reading avatar state or resolving media. kind=avatar_dance_video selects the active default Jolly’s unexpired bundled dances, the active ready-made Halloween look's six cache-backed dances, or the published final audio outputs of settled custom-avatar dances, with music resolved through get_audio. Only the active look's missing videos and paired frames are downloaded on demand; missing cache roles yield no attachment, without generating videos or showing plain Jolly instead. Every entry carries kind=avatar_dance_video, matching gallery attachments. Six complete dances return six attachments; base clips and final paths associated with multiple dance/aspect-ratio pairs are omitted. Optional audio.audio_asset_id carries the resolved song asset ID without the song:// prefix. A successful no_audio_configured result returns the final video without audio metadata. Missing kind returns an empty array without reading avatar state or resolving media. Unsupported kinds return 400. Music lookups are deduplicated by saved reference and share one 30-second deadline with at most six concurrent calls. Completed results are retained at expiry; unfinished or missing videos and failed or timed-out music lookups are omitted. If every lookup fails or times out, returns an empty array with HTTP 200. Default dance expiry_time is an exclusive UTC Unix-second cutoff evaluated at request start. Reads never generate videos, probe video streams or persist music metadata. Reading never writes preferences.Navigationdaemon_navigation_tab_order_setSave navbar and Spaces order togetherSaves navbar and spaces together, replacing both orders atomically and returning the normalized lists with Chat restored or moved to the first navbar position. Both lists accept system destinations and promoted local or saved Spaces. Identities must be unique across both lists and total at most 500 entries including Chat. Local or saved promotion is validated under the shared placement lock; stale membership returns 409 sidebar_changed. Omitted unlabelled references, including legacy system tabs and promoted artifacts, are retained without a section; a merged preference over 500 entries returns 400 sidebar_full without saving. A saved system tab other than Chat that the save omits keeps its saved place, after the nearest preceding entry still listed, so a save cannot remove a saved system tab by omitting it; clients may leave out system keys they do not render. The reply is the submitted lists as normalized, without the kept tabs; a later GET returns the stored order including them. Creation and promotion prepend only to spaces. Saving never changes placement or favorite_order. While the connection gate is on, either list accepts the system tab connections, and the position a save sends wins; with the gate off, a save naming it ignores that entry and the response omits it. A save from such an iOS build keeps each peer_space entry a read would list at its saved place. The route takes no query parameters. A successful save emits navigation.tab_order.updated with an empty payload to navigation subscribers; refetch after that event, after each initial subscription snapshot, and after creation or placement changes.
